review_notes: Complete RB727 native TIFF transcription supplemented by three photographs of the same physical sheet supplied by the user. The photographs recover all faded central rail labels, AK body and pin print, and the previously missing input stems. No bank departure is evidenced. Independent root review remains pending.

Photo 1 resolves RB807AN4 HOT ONE bit60, RB813AC4 AB56-63, RB807AY4 HOT ONE bit62, RB811AF4 AB64-67 L2, RB805AB4 AB24-31, RF061AZ4 F BIT06 B, and the AB62/63/64/30 origins. The F04-07 control is RB807AD4, independently supported by the native RB807 AD4 output crop. Literal +GT F04-07-PADDB60-63 is retained without an AB prefix or L2 suffix.

Photo 2 follows the left central diamonds and lower stems: AB56-63 feeds AW B13 and BB B13; AB63 feeds AX B05 and BB D13; AB24-31 feeds AV B09 and BA B09; F04-07 feeds AY D05 and BD D05; AB64-67 L2 feeds BC B07; AB64 feeds BK B04. The BK B03/D08 loop and upper AZ D04/D08 loop are separate source-visible passive jumpers with no inferred driver.

Photo 3 follows the right central diamonds and lower stems: AB62 feeds AG D09 and AL B12; AB56-63 feeds AF B13 and AL B13; F04-07 feeds AH D05 and AN D05; AB64 feeds AM B05; AB64-67 L2 feeds AM B07; HOT ONE bit62 feeds BL B04; F BIT06 B feeds AQ D06. AB24-31 feeds AE B09 and AK B09, and AB30 feeds AK B10. The top AB58-63 L2 rail feeds AX B07 and AG B07.

A second review of photo 3 and the native AP left-stem crop traced +F BIT 04 B / RF041BB4 upward into AP D04. It crosses the AR B02 output without a diamond. AR B02 separately feeds BG B08 and the bit61 continuation. AP plain lower D04 output doglegs under that AR line and then into AB D02 without joining it. This corrects the earlier private partial route.

Native 7E R TO gate ID is AB and lower 2M AND gate ID is BD. Photo 3 resolves AK as B10/B09, U03AA 0503A7, B-C1B4. All 30 card portions match A1; A1 corroborates physical identity but was not substituted for wire evidence.

The small AB64 row51 left bend into BK B04 is continuous in the photograph, but its diamond glyph is not reliably distinguishable. The net is connected in the graph while no open diamond is manufactured at that bend. Source-visible diamonds on the other central branch rails are modeled; ordinary crossings stay unjoined.

Native output stars follow AR B02, AA D02, AT D02, AC B02, BE lower D05, BF lower B03, and AQ lower D05. AA/AT KD10 and AC KB08 are same-block extra outputs joining at printed diamonds. AP D02/D04, BE E02, BF B04, and AQ B03 remain plain. Input star annotations ✲RF051AU4, ✲RF041BB4, ✲RF061AZ4, and ✲RF071AU4 remain separate from their primary captions.
